summary: Refined the walk motion for phi-pop to incorporate stylized hunched stalking staging, weighted vertical bobbing, squared contact lift arcs, and overlapping arm counter-swings without altering root displacement or clip duration.
expectedEffect: A more grounded, readable silhouette at game camera distance with distinct support intervals and weight transfer.
